verdict.rationale: Docs confirm scrape/crawl responses can be returned as Markdown or HTML (and other formats like screenshots or CSS-selected fields), giving developers format choice for core outputs (context-dev-docs-20, context-dev-docs-3). However, there is no evidence of a plain-text or frontmatter output option being selectable. Missing for 10: explicit plain-text output mode, explicit frontmatter output mode, and any parameter documentation showing all four formats as selectable options in one API.
